verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms https://docs.langchain.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index of every docs page. Individual pages such as overview.md are served as markdown and point agents back to the llms.txt index. Many cited docs URLs are .md variants, which confirms agent-readable docs across the LangGraph documentation. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on using llms.txt with agents, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) or an MCP docs server.
